page_title: BOU 2-2 SHU | Bournemouth v Sheffield Utd 09/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+8' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.

90+6' Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) get himself out of a tight corner inside the box then shoots. The keeper leaps for the ball but it flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
90+6' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) commits a foul during an attacking move.
90+5' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
90+1' 2 - 2 Goal! Enes Unal (Bournemouth) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 2:2.
90+1' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
88' Chris Mepham (Bournemouth) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Anthony Taylor ignores the protests.
88' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) receives a yellow card.

83' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) is quickest inside the box and leaps to connect with the resulting set piece. He produces a fine header, but it floats just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
83' The referee points to the corner flag and Bournemouth will take a corner.
81' The corner is swung in but Bournemouth can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
81' The booking goes to Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd).
80' Substitution. Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ollie Arblaster walks off.
80' Chris Wilder decides to make a substitution. Ben Brereton Diaz will be replaced by William Osula (Sheffield Utd).
79' Bournemouth win a corner.

79' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
74' Here is a change. Adam Smith is going off and Andoni Iraola gives the last tactical orders to Alex Scott (Bournemouth).
74' It's time for a substitution. Philip Billing (Bournemouth) comes on in place of Ryan Christie.
74' 1 - 2 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header straight under the crossbar. He makes it 1:2.
74' The ball goes out for a corner. Bournemouth can continue in their attacking effort.
72' Ivo Grbic (Sheffield Utd) is booked by the referee.

72' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
71' The corner from Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) is cleared away by the defence.
71' Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender. Bournemouth earn a corner.
69' Chris Wilder has decided to make a change. Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) replaces Jayden Bogle.
69' The referee allows time for a substitution. Oliver McBurnie will be replaced by James McAtee (Sheffield Utd).
68' The goal by Bournemouth is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a handball.
68' The Bournemouth players halt their celebrations as referee Anthony Taylor makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
67' Goal! Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:2.

64' Neto was forced into action to thwart Ollie Arblaster (Sheffield Utd). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Sheffield Utd.
64' Sheffield Utd have been awarded a corner kick.
64' 0 - 2 Goal! Jack Robinson (Sheffield Utd) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:2.
64' Rough tackle by Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
62' Andoni Iraola prepares a substitution. Justin Kluivert is replaced by Enes Unal (Bournemouth).
62' The game has come to an end for Marcus Tavernier. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth).
61' The foul by Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Anthony Taylor.
60' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bournemouth comes to nothing.

59' That's a well-taken pass by Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
56' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
55' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) sends a cross into the box, but Ivo Grbic comes off his line to gather the ball.

55' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Anthony Taylor with no other option than to blow for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Bournemouth.
54' Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
52' Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Neto, who smothers the ball.

50' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
49' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
47' Referee Anthony Taylor sees the trip by Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
47' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
46' Chris Wilder makes a half-time substitution. Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) comes on in place of Tom Davies.
46' The game is over for Milos Kerkez. Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) comes on for the second half.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' Anthony Taylor has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+5' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the top left corner. Ivo Grbic is alert and denies him with a nice save.
45+4' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) commits a rough challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul. Sheffield Utd have a free kick.
45+4' The referee awards a corner and Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) goes over to take it.

45+4' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Sheffield Utd.
45+3' Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
45+1' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

43' Ambitious effort from Ryan Christie (Bournemouth). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
41' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
39' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bournemouth.

39' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the top left corner. Ivo Grbic shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net. The referee blows his whistle, Bournemouth are awarded a corner kick.
37' A lofted cross from Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
36' Anthony Taylor shows the yellow card to Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) for a heavy challenge.
32' Chance! Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.

28' Neto pulls off a great save to deny Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
27' 0 - 1 Goal! Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.

25' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Ivo Grbic pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going inside the left-hand post.
24' Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Anthony Taylor saw the whole situation. Bournemouth are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
21' The resulting set piece from Bournemouth is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

21' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The ball is out of play. Bournemouth will have a chance to score from a corner.
20' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
19' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) gets to the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
18' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) will deliver the corner kick.

18' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Bournemouth are awarded a corner kick.
17' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Neto.
15' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Adam Smith (Bournemouth) gets booked.
15' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) misses the penalty! His poor effort goes well over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
14' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
13' Tom Davies (Sheffield Utd) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. PENALTY to Bournemouth! Great chance to score.
13' Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd) trips an opposition player and Anthony Taylor signals a foul. It's a free kick to Bournemouth in a dangerous position.

12' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and attempts to place his header into the middle of the goal. Neto shows his fast reflexes, though, and makes a nice save.
10' Anthony Taylor shows a yellow card to Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) for a tough tackle.
10' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
9' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle and signals a foul after Tom Davies (Sheffield Utd) brought his opponent down. There is a free kick near the sideline to Bournemouth.
8' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
7' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball. Bournemouth get a free kick.
6' A player from Bournemouth commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
5' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Adam Smith (Bournemouth).

4' He should have scored! Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Neto makes an easy save.

3' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going low in the middle of the goal, but Ivo Grbic has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
3' Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Bournemouth have been awarded a free kick.
2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bournemouth.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Bournemouth will have the kick-off.
Anthony Taylor will supervise the game today.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
